concepts.gloss_en: the other/remaining languages of the nations (the tongues excluding the Holy Tongue and Targum/Nogah, aspect of complete evil / bonfire of seventy stars)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical phrase in the same paragraph of lesson 19, referring to the same thing — the nations' languages excluding Holy Tongue/Targum. One frames them as 'bonfire of seventy stars,' the other as 'complete evil,' but these are two descriptions of the single concept, not two different words. Straightforward single-concept confirm.
